title: Check catalogues, compliance mapping, best-practice sources and crawler, benchmarks

checks.what: every check of the six platform registries with 401 and 403 on every read
guarded checks give the same result as bare checks on the sample tenant
pass / empty / 404 oracle for count checks across ZIA, ZPA, ZCC, ZDX, ZIdentity, RBAC
every cited reference is https on a Zscaler host
format regex per framework for every mapped control (NIST 800-53/171, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, CIS, CMMC L1-L3, CSF 2.0, GLBA)
CJIS is not a framework in compliance_mapping (it is covered by the CJIS policy pack and guidance topics)
links/sitemaps to http, metadata IP, loopback, userinfo, backslash, other hosts, javascript:, file: never fetched or listed
redirect hops checked against the allowlist by zscaler_update_check._safe_get (covered by tests/test_outbound_ssrf.py)
stdlib parser, script/style ignored, titles inert text
area mapping, stage progression, grades, percentages, totals
tenant status, capability parsing, candidate matching

findings.title: Checks judged reads the role was refused (401/403): FW.8 and AI.6 passed, ~69 checks said 'No X configured', 'not accessible' notes counted informational
findings.fix: permission guard (zscaler_full_checks.permission_guarded/guard_registry) wraps every check of the six platform registries and the SaaS/Email checks: a scored result built on a refused read becomes INFO 'Not permitted' (permissions.is_denied wording)

findings.title: Engine DLP registry (outside slice): 11 checks PASS on HTTP 403, e.g. MC.12 counts the error body as a rule
findings.fix: The permission guard moved into the engine and wraps REG after its splices, so API, MCP and CLI runs fail closed on a 401/403 read (the 11 named engine checks were already not permitted; 1.27/1.28 were not). Also ...::test_an_engine_check_built_on_a_refused_read_is_not_permitted

findings.title: Sitemap regex backtracked cubically on unclosed sitemap tags (18 KB = 4 s, 94 KB > 2 min): a hostile sitemap hangs the crawl
findings.fix: one linear pass over sitemap open/close tags; 8 MB parses in 0.16 s

findings.title: zscaler_update_check._safe_get reads the whole answer into memory with no size cap (outside this slice); the crawler's 8 MB/2 MB caps apply only after the download
findings.fix: Already fixed on integrate/w6 (update-heal slice): _safe_get streams with stream=True and _read_capped refuses an answer (declared or read) past MAX_BODY_BYTES (64 MB, sized for SDK wheels); no change needed

findings.title: RBAC.12 'Stale admin accounts' always passed: SDK UserRecord has no last-login field, so no evidence read as 'none stale'
findings.fix: no reported login time is INFO (not assessed); clock injectable (_now); booleans are not timestamps

findings.title: AI.9/AI.10 passed on substrings: 'Weekly report' (repo), 'Barcode' (code), 'Company confidential' (pan)
findings.fix: _has_any matches whole words

findings.title: Compliance mapping cited wrong control ids (ISO A.8.22, PCI DSS 10.7/9.7/1.4.5, CIS 13.10/10.7, CMMC 3.12.4, AU.L3-3.3.1e, HIPAA disposal, 800-171 Rev 3 label)
findings.fix: ids and titles corrected against the framework texts; format regex per framework tested for every control

findings.title: SaaS (C.x), Email (D.x), RBAC and ZIdentity checks mapped to no framework control
findings.fix: C./D. map to dlp, RBAC./ZID. to identity_admin

findings.title: Benchmarks filed sections 11 and 12 under Client Connector and SaaS/Email channels under Other, missing from the Coverage stage
findings.fix: prefix-only matching; Ch.C/Ch.D added to the DLP programme area and Coverage stage

findings.title: Benchmark markdown printed 'n/a%' and 'None%'; a saved report whose checks are not a list raised
findings.fix: _pct_text everywhere; checks filtered to dicts

findings.title: SaaS matrix: an INACTIVE tenant counted as active ('ACTIVE' in 'INACTIVE')
findings.fix: status list compared by whole token

findings.title: SaaS matrix: 'Not supported'/'Not available' cells parsed as supported; help page parsed without a size cap
findings.fix: negations refused first; page capped at 2 MB; parse errors give []

findings.title: SaaS matrix: a Box tenant hid Dropbox from the onboarding candidates (substring match)
findings.fix: whole-word match both ways

findings.title: D.6 / C.3 PASSed while their tenant list read was refused
findings.fix: SaaS/Email checks spliced into the engine registry through the permission guard

findings.title: Crawl cache read without type checks: a string timestamp raised TypeError in crawl()/last_summary (500 on the library page)
findings.fix: _load_cache drops fields of the wrong type

findings.title: Library store accepted javascript:/data:/http: URLs and unbounded titles; a malformed store raised KeyError
findings.fix: https-only URLs on read and save, titles capped at 300 chars, non-dict entries skipped

findings.title: lookup_by_topic matched short substrings: admin findings linked to the Deception Active Directory guide ('ad' in 'admin')
findings.fix: substrings count only at 3+ characters

findings.title: FW.2 judged a custom rule named '...default...', treated BLOCK_ICMP as not blocking, and raised on a null action
findings.fix: predefined defaultRule preferred; any BLOCK_* passes (action list assumed from the ZIA API reference; SDK 1.11.3 does not enumerate it)

findings.title: ZPA.8 passed with some Private Service Edges offline (ZPA.4 warns for App Connectors)
findings.fix: partial offline is REVIEW

findings.title: ZCC.4 crashed on the API's numeric osType (int.lower())
findings.fix: str() before lower()

findings.title: AUTO-SDK-01/02 raised AttributeError on a client without token/exp
findings.fix: getattr with default

findings.title: Benchmarks and compliance percentages use Python round() (half to even): 62.5% shows 62, 87.5% shows 88
findings.fix: kept: the engine score and compliance alignment use the same rounding, so the pages agree

findings.title: Quality-score loader refuses the wave-6 findings schema (files, coverage, proposed_patch), so every wave-6 record is dropped from the score
findings.fix: Resolved at integration (bde03b1: files, coverage, notes, baseline, proposed_patch keys); completed here: multi-line patches, coverage context, finding files, commit lists
